## Review checklist

- [ ] The linked issue describes one independently reviewable outcome.
- [ ] The change stays within the issue's agreed scope.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria have verification evidence; remaining gaps are explicit.
- [ ] Relevant type checks, tests, builds, and manual checks are recorded above.
- [ ] Risks, deployment impact, and rollback considerations are documented.
- [ ] Public text and evidence contain no secrets or private user data.
- [ ] Maintainer review is requested when this PR is ready; merge and deployment require explicit approval.
